description: This file defines the EmailSubscriberDao class, which manages database operations related to email subscribers within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for fetching, counting, saving, and deleting email subscriber records, as well as retrieving email subscription details.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing email subscriber data, extending the BaseDao for common database operations.

methods.name: getEmailSubscribersByEmailSubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of email subscribers associated with a specific email subscription ID, applying pagination and optional filtering based on 'enabled' status.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberByEmailSubscriptionIdPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator for email subscribers associated with a given email subscription ID, with filtering and sorting parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberListCountByEmailSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the count of email subscribers for a specific email subscription ID, considering applied filters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionById
methods.description: Fetches an EmailNotification entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: saveEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Persists an EmailSubscriber entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmailSubscriber by its ID and subscription ID, with null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingEmailSubscriberIds
methods.description: Returns an array of existing email subscriber IDs from a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmailSubscribersByIds
methods.description: Deletes multiple email subscribers by their IDs and returns the number of deleted records.
